name: 示例·墨黑改代码
author: Xinkgo
description: 演示 extends：整套沿用内建的墨黑，只把代码块换成深色

style.pre: margin: 0 0 1.2em; padding: 1em 1.1em; background: #23241f; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word;
style.pre>code: font-family: Menlo, Consolas, monospace; background: none; padding: 0; color: #d8d8d2;
